entities.name: Discovery Travel & Living
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
Discovery Travel & Living (also known as Travel & Living or TLC Travel & Living in some markets) was a television channel that operated as part of Discovery Communications' portfolio — focusing on travel, lifestyle, food, design, and home-oriented programming that appealed to aspirational middle-class audiences interested in global travel, gourmet food culture, home decoration, and lifestyle content, eventually evolving into the TLC (The Learning Channel) brand that Discovery reoriented toward lifestyle and reality television content.

Discovery Communications' channel portfolio strategy evolved significantly from the network's educational origins (Discovery Channel launched 1985 with nature/science focus) to encompass multiple specialized channels targeting different demographic segments: the shift from an educational 'Travel & Living' focus to reality television (The Learning Channel/TLC's reality TV pivot in the 2000s) reflected broader changes in cable television economics as reality television proved dramatically cheaper to produce than documentary and travel content.

Travel and lifestyle programming has played a significant role in shaping aspirational consumer culture, particularly in the globalization era: channels like Discovery Travel & Living and competitor Travel Channel contributed to democratizing visual travel experiences for audiences who couldn't afford to travel extensively, creating cultural familiarity with global destinations while stimulating travel demand. The food and cooking content from such channels has been part of the broader food culture revolution of the 2000s-2010s.
